header: Step 3: (Optional) Use the AWS Glue Schema Registry
content:
When you use OpenSearch Ingestion with Amazon MSK, you can use the AVRO data format for
schemas hosted in the AWS Glue Schema Registry. With the AWS Glue Schema Registry, you can
centrally discover, control, and evolve data stream schemas.
To use this option, enable the schema type in your pipeline conﬁguration:
schema:
type: "aws_glue"
You must also provide AWS Glue with read access permissions in your pipeline role. You can use the
AWS managed policy called AWSGlueSchemaRegistryReadonlyAccess. Additionally, your registry
must be in the same AWS account and Region as your OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.
